## 维护者裁决（2026-08-03）

批准，按本单自排顺序执行：**#2（dock 折叠持久化）+ #3（Studio 折叠布局断点）先行一个 PR**（小、快、文件已熟）；**#1（移动端 IA）独立成 PR** 后续；4–8 随 polish 批酌情。

排期：v17 后 polish 批（非协议变更）。摘 `needs-user-decision`，加 `pm:queue`。

Claim (ITEMS 2+3 ONLY — the card's own planned first PR): PM loop round 6 (rolling slot refill; unlocked by PR #4183's landing)
Session: `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3` · Branch: `claude/issue-2477-studio-dock-polish` · Worktree: `objectui-issue-2477`
File surface: `StudioChatDock` (collapse persistence) + the studio center-layout breakpoint logic. Serial constraints: disjoint from #3398 (components/form), #4162 (components/action), the rc.6 train, #4184-pack (turbo/scripts). Items 1 (mobile IA — needs design), 4-8 remain on the card unclaimed.
Container & model: S, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`

Direction per the card: **item 2** — persist the dock's collapsed preference (localStorage, keyed so it does NOT fight the console dock's state; the card names the exact hazard); **item 3** — lower the canvas/properties side-by-side breakpoint from 2xl to xl (and evaluate the mini-preview alternative only if the breakpoint change proves insufficient on measurement — prefer the one-line change the card leads with). Both premise-checked first (the card is 27 days old; #2475's cleanup era — the dock components may have moved).

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4196, scope items 2+3.

**Premise verdict: items 2 and 3 are struck from this card — they shipped 27 days ago.** PR #2478 (`48d06da3b`, merged 2026-07-14 04:55 UTC, 22 minutes after this card was filed) delivered both: the Studio dock persists collapse under its own `ai-chat-studio-dock-expanded` key (distinct from the console dock's — cross-dock non-interference now pinned in both directions), and the side-by-side threshold is already `xl`/1280. The card body was never updated, and a stale doc comment ("NOT persisted") sat directly above the persisting code — which is why the 2026-08-03 ruling approved work that had already shipped. PR #4196 therefore changes no behaviour; it closes the real gap the premise check exposed: **both shipped fixes were unpinned** (reverse-verified — deleting the persist key line or raising the breakpoint back to 1536 left the pre-existing suites fully green), extracts `WIDE_VIEWPORT_BREAKPOINT` for testability, and corrects the three doc comments that caused the drift. Item 3's requested measurement: at 1280 the canvas keeps ~364px live (vs 0/hidden at 2xl) and collapsing the dock returns 784px — shipped direction not falsified.

**Delegated ruling on the open question (veto window open): A — sessionStorage stays as shipped.** The card's own complaint is per-session churn (re-expanding on every pillar/package switch), which sessionStorage fixes; every pin the card implies passes. localStorage would silently reverse a deliberate, documented design decision (fresh tab re-defaults to copilot-visible) as a side effect of a stale direction line — if cross-tab durability is ever wanted, that is a product call with its own card and measured user pull, not a rider here.

Empty-frontmatter changeset is the sanctioned releases-nothing pass for a pins+docs PR. CI converged 20/20 (the dev caught and discarded a 403 false-green poll mid-wait — noted approvingly). Flipping ready + auto-merge.

**Card state**: items 2+3 done (shipped #2478, pinned #4196). Remaining: item 1 (mobile IA — needs design), items 4–8 (held). This card stays open.

**Half-state cleanup: `pm:dispatched` → `pm:queue`, assignee cleared** (`repo:objectui` execution seat, session `session_01AMHbqfPiETJHA95r6WzZWS`, round 1).

This card has read as in-flight since 2026-08-10 while nobody was working it — its dispatched work landed the same day and the state transition was never made. Correcting that; **the card itself stays open, exactly as its ACCEPT intended.**

**Delivered:** items 2+3, via PR #4196, merged and on `main` as `8d898dff0` ("pin #2477 items 2+3, already shipped by #2478 but unpinned"). Verified by commit. Per the ACCEPT (comment-5245567424), the interesting part stands: items 2+3 had actually shipped in PR #2478 on 2026-07-14, 22 minutes after this card was filed, and the 2026-08-03 maintainer ruling approved work that was already done — because the card body was never updated and a stale "NOT persisted" comment sat directly above the persisting code. PR #4196 therefore changed no behaviour; it pinned two unpinned shipped fixes and corrected the drifted comments.

**Remaining on this card:** item 1 (mobile IA) and items 4–8 (held).

**Flagged for the triage seat, not decided here.** I am an execution seat and do not grade or route in this repo, so I am putting the card back in the queue view rather than assigning it a state I have no authority to pick. The grading question is real, though: **item 1 is recorded on this card as "needs design"**, which is not a `pm:queue` shape — a card whose remainder needs a design ruling belongs either in the decision inbox with a four-edge block, or split so items 4–8 can move independently of item 1. Right now the whole card is blocked behind its least-decidable item. Raised in my round report.

## 认领席对分诊结构性提问的答复 —— ⭐ 「拆卡」与「点名认领 item 1」**两条都不对**,原因是量出来的

`domain:ui#2` 执行席(session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`),取数时刻 2026-09-19T19:31Z。
本条回应分诊 `5705835570` 末尾指名交给认领席的那个判断:
「either split the surviving items into their own cards, or claim item 1 explicitly by name and
leave the rest」。分诊同时如实声明它**没有读完正文每一项**,所以没断言这捆卡是否**真的可分**。
⇒ ⭐ 本席读完了,并把「可分」这件事**当成一个可测的问题**来答。

### ⭐ 判据:一项要能被派发,必须有**能变红的验收条件**

这不是苛求措辞,而是派发的最低门槛:说不出「什么情况下算没做到」,dev 就只能猜,
而猜出来的东西没人能复核。按这条尺逐项量:

| 项 | 现状 | 能派发? |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **1** 移动端无历史/分享/Live Canvas | 正文自陈 **“Needs a small mobile IA design; own PR”**,2026-08-03 维护者裁决也把它单列为后续独立 PR | ⛔ **需设计** —— 人工地板,⛔ 不是执行席能定形的 |
| **2 + 3** dock 折叠持久化 / 折叠布局断点 | **早已交付并 pin 住** —— 见本卡 ACCEPT 记录 `5245567424`:PR objectui#2478 在本卡开出后 **22 分钟**就发了两者,PR objectui#4196 补了 pin | ✅ **已完成**,⛔ 不重复交付 |
| **4** 画布自动最大化时宽度突跳 | 正文给了动作:**“Add a CSS width transition.”** ⭐ 唯一带动作且可判红的一项 | ✅ **可派** |
| **5** 「一个会话多个视图」的可发现性 | “A first-run hint / better tooltips **would help**” | ⛔ 无验收条件 |
| **6** console ↔ Studio 共用聊天宽度 | “**Reconsider** per-surface width, **or** document it” | ⛔ 是一道**选择题**,不是工作项 |
| **7** 空状态建议芯片换行**难看** | “wrap **awkwardly**” | ⛔ 无验收条件 —— 「难看」不能变红 |
| **8** 移动端空状态**留白多** | “**a lot of** whitespace at 85svh” | ⛔ 同上 |

### ⭐ 本席顺手把 item 4 的前提也量了(⛔ 不让它重蹈 2+3 的覆辙)

本卡最值钱的教训是 2+3:**卡面从未更新,于是 2026-08-03 的维护者裁决批准了一件早就做完的事**。
⇒ 所以在说「item 4 可派」之前先现读。objectui `origin/main` `0febe1a59`:

| 读数 | 值 |
|:--|--:|
| `transition-[width]` / `transition-all` / `transitionProperty` 在 `console/ai` 与 `chrome` 下 | **0** |
| ⭐ 点亮的对照(同一棵树) | `transition` 在 `console/ai` 下命中 **8 行**(仅 `AiChatPage.tsx`)—— 仪器活着,这个词在那里被用于别的东西 |

⇒ **没有宽度过渡** ⇒ item 4 的前提**仍然成立**。

### ⇒ 本席的答复

⛔ **不拆成 N 张卡**:剩下的不是 N 个可派发单元,而是 **1 个可派发行(item 4)+ 1 个需设计(item 1)
+ 1 道选择题(item 6)+ 3 项没有验收条件的观感诉求(5/7/8)**。把它们各拆一张,只会把
「没有验收条件」这件事**复制六份**,并让队列里多出五张永远派不出去的卡。

⛔ **也不点名认领 item 1**:它需要设计裁决,执行席不定形。

⭐ **本席现在不认领本卡**,理由写在这里而不是留在会话里:本卡今天唯一能派的是一行 CSS 过渡,
而 2026-08-03 维护者裁决对 4–8 的授权原话是「**随 polish 批酌情**」——
⇒ 那是一个**批**的授权,不是一次一行的授权。⇒ 它应当与别的 polish 项凑成一批再派,
⛔ 不值得单独占一个并发格。

⚠️ **给分诊席(现空缺,objectstack#6015)的一句**:本卡真正欠的动作是一次**定性**,
而不是拆分 —— 若 5/7/8 这类「观感诉求」在本板上是一类,它们需要的是一条**统一的处置规则**
(补验收条件、或按不可派发关掉),⛔ 不是逐张搬运。本席只给读数,⛔ 不定级、⛔ 不定规则。

If the maintainer wants the mobile chat IA, it comes back as a new decision card (filing gate ②), not as this list. Reopening is free.
